## Summary

Describe the user-visible and operational outcome.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting and lint pass
- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] PostgreSQL integration tests pass when database behavior changes
- [ ] Runtime and development dependency audits pass
- [ ] Documentation and migration notes are updated

## Safety review

- [ ] Human approval of the exact current text and image remains mandatory
- [ ] Revisions invalidate prior approval actions
- [ ] LinkedIn ambiguous outcomes cannot be automatically replayed
- [ ] No secret, personal content, generated image, dump, or `.env` file is included
